question: Does DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 match or beat GLM-5.3 Flash on easy text and GLM-5.3 on moderate text, when the comparison is fair on reasoning, grading and load?
why_a_rerun: The 2026-10-27 refresh compared DeepSeek with reasoning on to GLM with it off, mis-graded a correct re.VERBOSE regex, scored two correct answers 0 on unprompted word caps, and measured DeepSeek's latency while a 195-call tool pilot ran on the same Ollama subscription. See ../2026-10-27-model-refresh/ and rescore-old.json.
effort_probe: probe-effort.json and probe-controls.json. GLM: (none) is no reasoning, (low) and (high) barely reason, (medium) reasons. DeepSeek reasons the same at every suffix and under reasoning_effort, think:false and reasoning.enabled:false, so a no-reasoning DeepSeek arm cannot be sent through this proxy. Its arm keeps the (low) suffix only because that is what a route would send; the suffix had no measured effect.
case_choice: The refresh's easy and moderate sets, plus every unused check-graded case at difficulty 0 to 2. Judge-only cases are left out so no judge call or judge family bias enters. Cases were chosen before any reply was seen.

grading.checker: evals/checks.py with the re.VERBOSE / triple-quoted literal fix (tests/test_checks.py), applied to every arm
grading.primary: checks as specified in evals/outcome_specs.yaml, unchanged, including max_words
grading.secondary: the same checks without max_words; reported beside the primary, never used for the verdict

analysis.unit: case; each arm's score per case is the mean of its 3 samples
analysis.quality: paired candidate-minus-reference difference, 95% case-bootstrap interval, 10,000 draws, seed 11, centred paired bootstrap p
analysis.latency: per case, median of the 3 samples; reported as the median across cases with a 95% case-bootstrap interval, for total time and time to first answer token; plus the paired per-case ratio candidate/reference with its interval
analysis.tokens: completion tokens and reasoning characters per arm, descriptive only, never a quota saving

decision_rules.official: evals/admission.py general rule, unchanged: DeepSeek replaces the production incumbent if its mean score is no more than 0.5 below and its median total latency is at least 30% lower (same provider, so the other-provider path does not apply). Uses the clean latency of this run.
reported_beside_it_not_binding: non-inferior: paired quality interval lower bound above -0.5
superior: paired quality interval lower bound above 0
a proposed quality path for the owner to accept or reject: superior on quality with paired median latency ratio at most 1.5
decision_rules.reasoning_matched_comparison: DeepSeek against GLM medium is reported as model-against-model with reasoning on both sides. It informs, and does not decide, the production question.

budget.probe_note: 13 suffix probe, 8 control probe, and 13 by mistake: probe_controls.py imported probe_effort.py before it had a main guard, which reran the suffix probe

stops: three failed attempts on one cell
three empty replies in a row from one arm
out_of_scope: The tool lane (GLM-5.3 high). The refresh's tool pilot leaked hidden-test names through .pytest_cache; it needs evals/run_sessions.py to run checks on an isolated copy before a tool rerun means anything. The probe also shows GLM (high) barely reasons through this proxy, which matters for that lane.
